description: This Python source file defines a class 'CustomOpenAPISpec' that provides static methods for customizing and augmenting OpenAPI specifications with Pydantic models, including adding schemas, request bodies, and handling references for documentation purposes without runtime validation.

classes.name: CustomOpenAPISpec
classes.description: A handler class providing static methods to customize OpenAPI specifications with Pydantic models, including adding schemas, request bodies, and handling references for documentation purposes.

methods.name: get_pydantic_schema
methods.description: Retrieves JSON schema from a Pydantic model, handling both v1 and v2 APIs, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: add_schema_to_components
methods.description: Adds a schema definition to the OpenAPI components/schemas section, ensuring the structure exists.

methods.name: add_request_body_to_paths
methods.description: Adds an expanded request body with individual fields to specified API paths for better Swagger UI display.

methods.name: _move_defs_to_components
methods.description: Moves $defs from Pydantic v2 schema to OpenAPI components/schemas, recursively processing nested definitions.

methods.name: _rewrite_defs_refs
methods.description: Recursively rewrites $ref values from #/$defs/... to #/components/schemas/... for OpenAPI compatibility.

methods.name: _extract_field_schema
methods.description: Extracts a simplified schema from a Pydantic field definition for display in OpenAPI parameters.

methods.name: _expand_field_definition
methods.description: Returns a full, inline schema for a Pydantic field definition suitable for OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: add_request_schema
methods.description: Generic method to add a request schema to OpenAPI, including adding to components and paths.

methods.name: add_chat_completion_request_schema
methods.description: Adds ProxyChatCompletionRequest schema to chat completion endpoints for documentation.

methods.name: add_embedding_request_schema
methods.description: Adds EmbeddingRequest schema to embedding endpoints for documentation.

methods.name: add_responses_api_request_schema
methods.description: Adds ResponsesAPIRequestParams schema to responses API endpoints for documentation.

methods.name: add_llm_api_request_schema_body
methods.description: Adds multiple LLM API request schemas to the OpenAPI specification for documentation.
